raw_text: Confirmed: AIIMS Delhi hit by ransomware. Multiple sources inside the hospital have confirmed what appears to be a major ransomware attack. Key details: 1) Patient records system (e-Hospital) completely encrypted. 2) Smart lab, billing, report generation all down. 3) Staff reverting to paper-based registration. 4) Initial indicators suggest compromise may have occurred days ago. 5) NIC (National Informatics Centre) team on-site. 6) This is likely one of the largest healthcare cyberattacks in India's history. The attack surface at AIIMS is massive — legacy systems, thousands of endpoints, minimal segmentation.
